import json, sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('.cache/overnight-code').resolve()))
from diagnose.model import LocalModel
from diagnose.runner import run
bank=json.load(open('data/freeway.json'))['situations']
stop=datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-13T08:30:00+00:00').timestamp()
for tag in ['qwen3:1.7b-q4_K_M','qwen3:4b-q4_K_M']:
 m=LocalModel(tag,cache='.cache/model',timeout=120)
 profile=json.load(open('results/cycle/'+tag.replace(':','-')+'/profile.json'))
 run(bank,m,Path('results/overnight-code')/tag.replace(':','-'),stages=('B',),representations=(profile['best_representation'],),seeds=tuple(range(5)),horizons=(1,5,10),repairs=('base','rule','scratchpad','chained','code','code_v2','tool'),split='test',limit=5,max_tokens=512,stop_at=stop)
 m.transport('/api/generate',{'model':m.name,'keep_alive':0})
